title: On Hamilton cycles in connected vertex-transitive graphs of order $2pq$
summary: The existence of Hamilton cycles in connected vertex-transitive graphs is a core open problem in algebraic graph theory, originating from Lovász's 1969 conjecture. All connected vertex-transitive graphs of order $pq$ are known to be Hamiltonian except the Petersen graph, and primitive graph of order $2pq$ are resolved except the Coxeter graph. This paper considers connected vertex-transitive graphs of order $2pq$ where every transitive automorphism subgroup admits a maximal intransitive normal subgroup inducing prime-length orbits.
